description.en: Copies a position kept by the script system for the controlled character into an array (at most 3 values: x, y, z). By its name and its use in ev43040000, where the player is walked back to it before leaving, it is where the character stood before the event.

true once copied.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Walking the player back (real usage, from ev43040000.nut)
